page.layout: One page of text in the centre; marginal notes in the right margin beside the text; a block of small italic notes below the text; a fragment of the facing page's margin at the far left (not transcribed). The text runs from the running head down to the foot of the column.

main_text.p: dem æquali pondere cum plumbo libratum in aëre, si stateram sub aqua demergas, ascendere, plus tamen ponderis hunc lapidem, quam istud plumbum (quod item ad trutinam examinare potes) in fundum aquæ derivare? Cedo, solaris circuitionis prærogatiuas: si vel unam dederis, dabo victas manus. Satis est, Amor-sapientiæ, ferendæ sententiæ, silentium poscit.Eximè jam stateram A. exaqua : & parata sim alia statera major D., in cujus una lance sit aquæ situla E.; in altera lance, aquæ situla F.: atque hæ situla E.

& F. simul cum aquis, quas continent, aquiponderent: Cape prædictum lapidem B., eumque ex fune ligatum & suspensum, demerge in situlam E.: ita manu funem tene, ut quidem lapis B in aqua situla E., penitus demersus sit; sed nec fundum nec latera situla E. contingat. Sit etiam alius tecum, qui plumbum C eodem modo ex fune suspensum, eodem modo demergat in situlam F.: Videbis illam lancem statera D., quæ continet situlam E, cui immergitur lapis B., deprimi; oppositam vero lancem ejusdem staterae D., quæ continet situlam F., cui immergitur plumbum C. attolli. Horum nobis in promptu quidem ratio; sed hîc non promenda.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small italic and partly cut off; the left margin shows the edge of the facing page, not transcribed. Several words in the right-hand notes and the foot note are doubtful, notably "sim" and "hæ situla", and the final line of the foot note.
